scale.note: surveyed pitch metres from the image->pitch homography

defs.d: separation |b-a| in metres, Savitzky-Golay w<=11 o2
defs.theta: bearing of b from a in degrees, 0 = +x axis, wrapped to [-180,180]
defs.omega: line-of-sight rotation rate d(theta)/dt in deg/s; theta is unwrapped before np.gradient and clipped to +/-720 deg/s
defs.closing: d(d)/dt in m/s; NEGATIVE means the pair is closing; clipped to +/-22 m/s, twice the speed clamp
defs.sync: Kuramoto order |mean(exp(i*phase))| over the Hilbert phases of every track's mean-removed pitch-x; a track needs 24 observed frames to get a phase and a frame needs 6 phases, else sync is null
defs.stretch: mean radial distance of the team from its centroid, metres
defs.voronoi: 4x mirrored Voronoi, Sutherland-Hodgman clipped to the pitch
